description: Schema for extracting job postings from listing, search results, or browse pages. Each record represents one job card as shown on the listing page.

location.description: Job location as shown (city, region, country, or 'Remote').
location.normalization: Normalize to 'City, Region, Country' where possible.

country.description: Country of the job location, when the site separates it from city/region.

salary.description: Salary shown on the listing card. Structured as {min_amount, max_amount, currency: {name, code, symbol}, period}. Null if not shown.
salary.normalization: Extract numerical min/max, ISO 4217 currency code, and period (year/month/hour). Set to null if absent.

employment_type.description: Employment type as shown (e.g. 'Permanent, full-time', 'Contract'). Retain original string.

posted_date.description: Date the job was posted. Normalize to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
posted_date.normalization: Convert to YYYY-MM-DD. Resolve relative dates using the snapshot date.

application_deadline.description: Application closing date. Normalize to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

work_arrangement.description: Work arrangement shown on the card.

qualifications.description: Key qualification snippets shown on the listing card.

job_description.description: Short description or teaser text shown on the listing card.

apply_url.description: Direct application URL when distinct from job_url.

company_logo_url.description: URL of the company logo as shown on the listing card.

job_id.description: Internal job identifier used by the site.

normalization_rules.salary: Extract min_amount and max_amount as numbers, currency as {name, code, symbol}, period as one of: year, month, hour. Set to null if not advertised.
normalization_rules.posted_date: Convert to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Resolve relative expressions (e.g. '3 days ago') using the snapshot date.
normalization_rules.location: Normalize to 'City, Region, Country' where possible. Use 'Remote' for fully remote roles.

notes: Only extract fields visible on the listing/card itself — do not navigate to detail pages.
'company_name' and 'location' are expected on most sites but may be absent on some (e.g. GitHub listing omits company_name; UNJobs listing omits location).
'salary' replaces the old 'salary_range' string field. Use the structured object form.
Use 'application_deadline' (not 'closing_date') to match actual field names in gold data.
